scope: Finite independent guarded-bootstrap protocol controls; no whole-project gold and no general solver-equivalence proof
authoring_order: Frozen from the Round14 design before candidate predictions; later executable adapters must retain these expectations
candidate_policy: eager_inert, only if exact native admission succeeds

cases.setup: One empty native module; admit one builtin seed
required: The processed NormalNode and the distinct Ctx location contain the builtin
A later PFG subscription replays that old fact

cases.setup: Register a native load constraint after seed publication, then publish an additional source object
required: The late rule receives old builtin facts
The late rule also receives future source growth

cases.setup: Register an ordinary builtin replay token after eager publication, using the same logical registration point before the queued control solves
required: No necessary queued-control invocation is lost
No duplicate invocation of the same token within the same pending replay set

cases.setup: Processor handle_pts records NormalNode-before-Ctx order and installs a sink
required: Admission falls back to queued work
The sink and hook observations equal the queued control

cases.setup: An instance override of state.get_variable creates an observable marker
required: Admission falls back without suppressing the address hook
Returned cached requests do not move singleton creation ahead of first address resolution

cases.setup: The same module location has an unprocessed work item before initialization
required: Admission declines for that location
Existing and seed values are both retained after solving

cases.setup: Ctx contains a value while processed NormalNode is empty
required: The location is not treated as fresh
Later PFG propagation retains both applicable values

cases.setup: Processed NormalNode contains a value while Ctx is empty
required: The location is not treated as fresh
The distinct storage roles are preserved

cases.setup: Two module scopes share pure builtin templates, then only one module receives another len value
required: The other module's len store does not receive that unrelated write
Late consumers of the written module receive both values

cases.setup: Supply an exact template record with missing seed rows
required: Candidate declines untrusted cached requests and reconstructs fresh requests
No IndexError escapes

cases.setup: Supply an exact template record with a wrong-name variable or builtin object
required: Wrong-name cached requests are not published as the requested builtin
Fresh correct builtin requests are retained

cases.setup: Supply a cached row containing the requested builtin plus an unrelated builtin
required: The row is not admitted as a pure singleton
Fresh initialization does not leak the unrelated value

cases.setup: Reset the object arena after producing templates, then intern an unrelated object at a reused bit
required: Old bare masks are not reused
Fresh builtin objects are decoded correctly

cases.setup: Reuse templates with a distinct context object or custom context implementation
required: The cache is declined where the exact native context guard is not satisfied

cases.setup: Compare one finite queued arm with the admitted eager arm
required: Selected and bootstrap publications are reported separately
Logical work includes both categories
The selected-work reduction is not called a reduction of logical solver work

boundaries: Native guard assumptions do not certify arbitrary later mutation of processors, stores, worklists, or object arenas
Agreement of finite raw states and callbacks does not prove every Python builtin summary
Configured budget units must be declared separately if bootstrap publication changes when a work budget is charged
